camel_example: aliyun eiam CreateTrustedOrigin --region cn-hangzhou --Origin 'https://console.qoder.com' --TrustedOriginScene.1 iframe_embed --InstanceId idaas_example
kebab_example: aliyun eiam create-trusted-origin --instance-id idaas_example --origin https://console.qoder.com --trusted-origin-scene iframe_embed --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTrustedOrigin

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IDaaS EIAM instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the trusted origin used for management, display, and auditing. If not specified, the value is empty
parameters.help_zh: 用于管理、展示和审计的可信来源名称，不传则为空
parameters.name: trust_origin_name

parameters.help_en: The browser origin in the format of scheme://host[:port]. This value cannot be modified after creation
parameters.help_zh: 格式为scheme://host[:port]，创建后不可修改
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en: The trusted origin scenes. Only iframe_embed and cors are supported. At least one value is required
parameters.name: trusted_origin_scene

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
